question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

There will __________ be handsome profits to be made.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**still**" is used to indicate that something is continuing to happen or is true at a particular time despite other events. (अब भी)
 
• Example: Despite the challenges, there were still opportunities to be explored.
 
• In the context, "There will **still** be handsome profits to be made" means that profits will continue to be available.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**still**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *There will **still** be handsome profits to be made.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Until (तक)**: Used to specify a point in time until which something continues.

 
 
• **Example: **We waited until he arrived.
 
 
 
• **Yet (अभी तक)**: Used to indicate something that has not happened by a particular time.
 
 
• **Example: **She has not finished her work yet.
 
 
 
• **Unto (तक/की ओर, archaic form)**: An old-fashioned preposition not commonly used in modern English context for this sentence structure.
